title: 250 Needlerush | Royal Destinations
meta_description: Located in WaterColor with Complimentary LSV (Low Speed Vehicle)- 250 Needlerush by Royal Destinations
description_expanded: Description: 250 Needlerush by Royal Destinations Location: WaterColor, Lake District Address: 250 Needlerush Dr Details: 250 Needlerush is a custom coastal retreat prominently located in the desirable Lake District of WaterColor. Boasting 4 bedrooms and 4.5 bathrooms, the home provides both ample space for families and friends to gather and relax, and enough privacy for a cozy personal oasis. Upon entering the home, you are welcomed to the open living space with raised ceilings, shiplap walls and carefully designed finishes and decor. Those who love to cook will enjoy the gourmet kitchen featuring a Wolf gas cooktop, Subzero fridge/freezer, breakfast bar, center island, and granite countertops. Each room has been thoughtfully designed and decorated to reflect a modern coastal style. The open concept design allows the perfect space to interact with family and friends. No detail was overlooked in the design and décor of the 4 bedrooms and 4.5 bathrooms, featuring walk-in closets in every room. This is the perfect place to make lifelong memories in this amazing WaterColor home. If you’re looking to plan less and experience more, contact the Royal Destinations team to discover your perfect 30A vacation rental. Known for unrivaled guest satisfaction, our team is committed to providing hand-tailored experiences that go beyond the four walls of your 30A luxury vacation rental. Home Highlights: -Distance to Beach Access: 0.7 miles (3-Minute Bike Ride) -Access to all WaterColor amenities including the WaterColor Trolley -LSV (Low Speed Vehicle) Included (6 Seater) -2 Screened-In Patios -Parking Spaces: 2 - 3 -Dining Accommodations: Table for 6, Bar Seating for 4 -Coffee Pot and Keurig Available *Please contact the reservations team for more information! -Both coffee pot and Keurig -8 Backpack Beach Chairs -Complimentary Beach Towels WaterColor Neighborhood Highlights: -Named the #1 Family Vacation Destination in the U.S. -A 499-Acre Coastal Resort and Residential Community -New On Demand + Point-to-Point WaterColor Trolley System -Bike Community -Award-Winning Tennis + Pickleball Facilities -Beachside, Poolside and Lakeside Dining -Nearby State Parks and Preserves -4 Swimming Pools Home Configuration + Sleeping Arrangements: Sleeps: 12 4 Bedrooms / 4.5 Bathrooms First Floor: -Bedroom 1 (Master): King Bed with Private Bath (Soaking Tub and Shower) -Bedroom 2: Queen Bed with Private Bath (Shower) -Kitchen / Dining Area / Living Room -Half Bath -Laundry Room Second Floor: -Bedroom 3: King Bed with Private Bath (Shower/Tub Combo) -Bedroom 4: Queen bed (Shared Bath) -Bunkroom: Two Twin over Twin Bunks (Shared Bath) -Hall Bath (Shower/Tub Combo) -Den Amenities Include: -4 Adult Bikes Please Note: *Beach access locations and beach vending companies are subject to change, per local county ordinances. For the most up-to-date information, please contact our office prior to your arrival. Lined with artsy villages, coastal lakes, upscale boutiques, eclectic beach bars, and world-class restaurants, Florida's Scenic Highway 30A has something for everyone. This unique destination has 25,000 acres of protected habitats. Among many things, this area is known for its family-friendly environment and is home to the world's most beautiful white sand beaches. The Timpoochee Trail bike path connects all the villages of 30A. Be sure to take your bike out and explore! The villages of 30A include: Dune Allen Beach, Blue Mountain Beach, Grayton Beach, WaterColor, Seaside, Seagrove Beach, WaterSound, Alys Beach, Seacrest Beach, Rosemary Beach, and Inlet Beach.
